name: Nikutai Ten'i
source:
Ken'ichi and several of his friends gather at their school during summer vacation to look at a new archaeological find, a bizarre looking mirror. Suddenly, the entire building is transported to an alternate dimension and a magic field surrounds it to prevent them from escaping. Also, their minds have switched to other people's bodies. They now must find a way to return everything back to normal until the dimension falls apart.

[Edited from [url=https://www.animenewsnetwork.com/encyclopedia/anime.php?id=4654]ANN[/url]]
translation:
暑假期间，健一与几名朋友在学校集合，准备查看一件新出土的考古发现——一面外形奇异的镜子。突然，整栋建筑被传送到异次元，并被魔法力场包围，令他们无法逃脱。此外，他们的意识还互换到了其他人的身体中。在这个空间崩溃前，他们必须找到让一切恢复正常的方法。

[Edited from [url=https://www.animenewsnetwork.com/encyclopedia/anime.php?id=4654]ANN[/url]]
